IntProperty1Hint:
The id of the model in either
the common geobj file or the stage's
specific geobj file,
depending on the value
in the next field
IntProperty2Hint:
A value of 1 means the model
for this will be pulled from the
common geobj, otherwise it will
be sourced from the world
specific geobj
